name: Hakoiri Shoujo -Virgin Territory-
source:
A prestigious institution, Sakuradani Academy is like a beautiful, isolated garden, designed to shield the daughters of wealthy families from the corrupt outside world.
The protagonist, Masayoshi Kannari, has been teaching there for about four years.
Though still relatively young, he’s well-liked by both staff and students as a “kind and sincere teacher.”

But in truth, he’s a predator—a lecherous educator who uses his gentle facade and silver tongue to seduce unsuspecting girls.
He finds it all laughable.
At the end of the day, women are all the same. He’s grown jaded by the girls who throw themselves at him without him even trying.

Then, his attention is caught by Yukino Kirihara, a timid and beautiful girl who’s become somewhat isolated in class.
Yukino is different—she’s the “real deal.” Her noble demeanor, respected even by her peers, stirs something in Masayoshi for the first time in a while.

As a teacher, he earnestly listens to Yukino’s concerns, all while sizing her up as his next target.
And Yukino, in turn, begins to develop a faint affection for him…

[Translated from [url=http://www.crg-a.com/work/hakoirisyoujyo/#story]the official website[/url]]
translation:
樱谷学院是一所享有盛誉的机构，它就像一座美丽而孤立的花园，旨在保护富裕家庭的女儿免受腐败的外部世界的侵害。
主人公神成正义已经在那里教书四年了。
尽管他还比较年轻，但他作为一位“善良而真诚的老师”而受到教职员工和学生的喜爱。

但事实上，他是一个掠夺者——一个好色的教育家，用他温柔的外表和巧舌如簧来引诱毫无戒心的女孩。
他觉得这一切都很可笑。
说到底，女人都是一样的。他已经厌倦了那些未经他尝试就向他扑来的女孩。

然后，他的注意力被桐原雪乃吸引了，她是一个胆怯而美丽的女孩，在课堂上变得有些孤立。
雪乃不同——她是“货真价实”的人。她的高贵举止甚至受到同龄人的尊重，这在一段时间内第一次激起了正芳的一些情绪。

作为一名老师，他认真倾听雪乃的担忧，同时将她视为下一个目标。
而雪乃也开始对他产生了淡淡的好感……

[翻译自[url=http://www.crg-a.com/work/hakoirisyoujyo/#story]官网[/url]]
